_comment: Project-level Claude Code hooks (template). 主线分支与 PROGRESS 路径通过 git/gh CLI 自动检测；如自动检测失败，把 [PROGRESS_PATH] 改成项目实际值。

PreToolUse._comment: H1 — 拦危险 Bash cmd: 1) git hook bypass; 2) force-push main; 3) rm -rf 保护目录; 4) chained pipe with git checkout/merge

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(echo|printf|cat[[:space:]]+<<)'; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit[[:space:]]+(commit|push|merge|rebase|stash|tag|cherry-pick|am|revert)\b.*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign|-c[[:space:]]+commit\.gpgsign=false)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: git hook bypass forbidden. Investigate root cause."}'; exit 0; fi; MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push.*-f.*\\b(main|$MAIN_BRANCH)\\b"; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: force-push to main branch forbidden."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*(\.claude|docs|migrations)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: rm -rf protected dirs (.claude/docs/migrations)."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|merge|rebase|reset)\b.*\|[[:space:]]*(tail|head|awk)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: chained pipe with git checkout/merge eats fatal exit code. Use independent Bash calls."}'; exit 0; fi; CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+merge\b' && { [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" = "$MAIN_BRANCH" ] || echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch)[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH([[:space:]]|&&|;|$)"; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: merge to main ($MAIN_BRANCH) is human-only. AI must not execute — ask the human to run it manually."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PreToolUse._comment: H2-pre — sprint merge 前检查：sprint 分支 last commit 是否触及 progress.md（新工作流：progress update 应作为 sprint 分支最后一个 commit）。未触及则警告（不 deny，允许 design-only 等场景）。

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH\\."; then SPRINT_BRANCH=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE "$MAIN_BRANCH\\.[^[:space:]\"']+" | head -1); if [ -n "$SPRINT_BRANCH" ]; then LAST_FILES=$(git log -1 --name-only --pretty=format: "$SPRINT_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'); if ! echo "$LAST_FILES" | grep -qiE '(^|/)progress\.md$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ Pre-merge check: sprint branch '"'"'"$SPRINT_BRANCH"'"'"' last commit does not touch progress.md. Per workflow: update progress.md as the FINAL commit on sprint branch before merging. Continue if intentional (e.g. design-only sprint or chore branch)."}'; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PostToolUse._comment: H2-post — sprint merge 后兜底：若 merge commit 未触及 progress.md（pre 检查被跳过 / sprint 分支没更新就 merge 了），提示开 chore.progress 补救（per progress-conventions.md 例外条款）

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH\\."; then LAST_FILES=$(git log -1 --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'); if ! echo "$LAST_FILES" | grep -qiE '(^|/)progress\.md$'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ Merge done but does not include progress.md update. Open chore.progress branch to补救 (per progress-conventions.md 例外条款)."}'; exit 0; fi; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

SessionStart._comment: H5 — agent loader: .enabled から缺失 agent を项目内 .claude/agents に复制；正常无输出
H6 — 会话起 work state 摘要 + PROGRESS 行数检查

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); LAST3=$(git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | head -3 | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//'); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/$MAIN_BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); PROGRESS_PATH="[PROGRESS_PATH]"; if [ "$PROGRESS_PATH" = "[PROGRESS_PATH]" ] || [ ! -f "$PROGRESS_PATH" ]; then PROGRESS_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -iname 'progress.md' 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; LINES=$(wc -l < "$PROGRESS_PATH" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); OPEN=$(gh issue list --state open 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0); WARN=""; if [ "$LINES" -gt 250 ]; then WARN=" | ⚠️ PROGRESS $LINES lines > 250 — 触发归档"; fi; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Branch: $BRANCH | ahead $AHEAD | open issues: $OPEN | PROGRESS: $LINES lines$WARN | last: $LAST3\"}"; exit 0

SessionEnd._comment: H7 — 本地 session learning 记录；只写 .claude/session-memory/，不调用模型，不输出上下文
